description: This file defines classes and functions for managing Android instrumentation test suites, including creating test instances from Android manifests, configuring test parameters, and running tests via ADB with coverage support.

classes.name: InstrumentationTestSuite
classes.description: Represents a Java instrumentation test suite run on an Android device, with methods to configure and execute tests, including coverage collection.

classes.name: InstrumentationTestFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating InstrumentationTestSuite instances based on Android manifest and directory structure.

methods.name: HasInstrumentationTest
methods.description: Checks if a given path contains an Android instrumentation test by parsing the manifest.

methods.name: CreateTests
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of InstrumentationTestSuite objects based on manifest data and optional sub-path filters.

methods.name: _IsJavaFile
methods.description: Determines if a given path is a Java file.

methods.name: _IsJavaFileName
methods.description: Checks if a filename has a .java extension.

methods.name: _IsJavaPackage
methods.description: Checks if a directory contains Java files, indicating a Java package.

methods.name: _GetClassNameFromFile
methods.description: Extracts the fully qualified Java class name from a Java file path.

methods.name: _GetPackageNameFromDir
methods.description: Gets the Java package name associated with a directory by inspecting Java files.

methods.name: _GetPackageNameFromFile
methods.description: Extracts the Java package name from a Java file by parsing its content.
